## Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

# COVID

```{r}
# Read in data
covid_data <- read.csv("~/covid.csv", head=TRUE)
head(covid_data)
```

```{r}
covid_lm <- lm(Deaths ~ Confirmed, data = covid_data)

covid_data %>%
  mutate(predicted = covid_lm$fitted.values) %>%
  ggplot(., mapping = aes(x = Confirmed, y = Deaths)) +
    geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = FALSE, col = 'red') +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = Confirmed, yend = predicted), col = 'blue', alpha = .5) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = 'Relationship Between COVID Confirmed Cases and Deaths', x = 'Confirmed Cases', y = 'Deaths') +
  theme_bw()
```
